gameVisualTarget.theme: INTER-ANIME TOURNAMENT: 16 anime fighters in one glowing circular Tournament Arena (MUGEN-inspired 3D fighting game)
gameVisualTarget.artDirection: Cel-shaded 3D anime game look (world visualStyle cel-shaded-3d-game): toon shading, dark outlines, dramatic arena lighting, glowing rim
gameVisualTarget.camera: Third-person chase camera behind the player that keeps the opponent framed; mouse orbit/zoom
gameVisualTarget.tone: High-energy anime tournament, dramatic and bright
